title: SECTION VII — THE PHILOSOPHICAL SKY OF MANY DIRECTIONS
summary: The collection’s widest comparative philosophical panorama. Indian and Western traditions appear through recurring problems of being, cause, knowledge, language, duty, society, faith, freedom, experience and consciousness. Rather than collapsing traditions into one doctrine, the sequence places many conceptual routes under a shared sky and asks what each route illuminates or leaves unresolved.
